title: The Block Museum of Art

services.name: Exhibition Tours
services.desc: Urban historian Lewis Mumford noted “the city creates the theater and is the theater”. Picturing the Modern Metropolis: Prints and Photographs from The Block's Collection provides the opportunity to revisit his correlation of the city with theater by examining images of the city as theatrical stills. In this talk, Greg Foster-Rice, co-curator of The City Lost and Found: Capturing New York, Chicago, and Los Angeles, 1960-1980 (Art Institute of Chicago, 2015) will explore key images and themes from the Block Museum of Art’s current exhibition.
